authority: Dor requests verification and directs a generic design per exercise type, avoiding per-exercise Figma work.
conclusion: Use Figma for reusable interaction templates, meaningful states and a small representative flow. Keep lesson content separate. A new phrase, question, option, dialogue turn or audio clip does not itself justify another frame or user Present checkpoint.

new_figma_work_gate.content_only_change: Update the approved content record; reuse the existing template. Do not create another frame/variant or request another Present check solely for a wording/audio substitution.
new_figma_work_gate.variants: Represent interaction states; do not create variants for every word, exercise id, speaker name or content item.
new_figma_work_gate.sample_strategy: One representative example per interaction type, plus targeted long-text/RTL/error cases where needed. User checks cover behavior or a real decision, not every repeated content item.
new_figma_work_gate.existing_frames: Keep current frames as examples. No bulk cleanup/refactor is needed merely to implement this policy; no new per-content copies.
